name: dogfood-sqlite-wal-fts-app
description: Dogfood app (v1.32-4) — a SQLite WAL + FTS5 full-text search notebook backed by Bun-style edge deployment semantics driven by @kiwa-lab/orm v0.10 in KIWA_MODE=mock and libsql/turso edge driver in KIWA_MODE=real (env-skip SQLITE_KEY). Behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 13-axis release gate + Playwright e2e for wal-checkpoint / fts5-query / edge-latency / testcontainers-probe flows.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/orm @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --hookTimeout 30000
